ja278:1.1: Kam attham abhisandhāya lahucittassa dūbhino sabbakāmaduhassevā imaṃ dukkhaṃ titikkhasi.
ja278:2.1: Siṅgena nihanāh' etaṃ padasā ca adhiṭṭhaha, bhiyyo bālā pakujjheyyuṃ no c' assa paṭisedhako ti.
ja278:3.1: Mam evāyaṃ maññamāno aññam p' eva karissati, te taṃ tattha vadhissanti, sā me mutti bhavissatīti.
